screen.subject: BJT模擬テスト 採点結果
screen.line: 聴解：会話の設問が低い

lines.en: Hello, and welcome to Kamaru Business Japanese.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Today is lesson 10: 25 words — goals & results.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: First, let's listen to a conversation on the walk from the station.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Good morning, Kimura. The scores for last week's BJT mock test are out.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: Good morning. How was it? I hope it's not worse than I imagined.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: On the whole, not bad. But some of the listening questions scored low.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: I see. Could you give me one concrete example?
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Questions where three or more people appear in the conversation. It seems you lost track of who said what.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: True. Just like real meetings, it's hard when lots of people are talking.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: As a way to fix it, how about starting to listen to the news every morning?
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: Good idea. Around thirty minutes a day, I think I can keep that up.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: And one point to note: it's worth reviewing basic keigo again too.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: OK. Is there any other related practice before the real test?
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: There are three candidate workbooks that focus on business situations.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: Those sound better than general workbooks.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Yes. Your results from here on should help your hopes of promotion too.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: Thank you. I'll make a concrete plan and work hard.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Now let's go through today's words one by one. First: tests & scoring.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: A question set in a test.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Answer the following question.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: Looking at answers and giving marks.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The teacher is marking the tests.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Saying words out loud.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: In this question, listen carefully to the last thing said.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: A person or thing appearing in a story or scene.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Three people appear in this conversation.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: How much; the extent.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: It'll take about an hour.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: The options before one is chosen.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: We picked three candidate venues.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Widely seen; typical.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: This is the usual way to do it.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: Forming the basis of something.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: First I'll explain the basic rules.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Next: solving problems.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Sorting a problem out.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: We talked it through and solved the problem.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: A way of reaching a goal.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Email is the most common way we get in touch.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Doing things for a purpose.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: We do volunteer work through the company.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: Starting something.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The exam starts at nine.
lines.name: 木村

segments.meaning: to be related, to be connected

lines.en: Being connected with each other.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Please send the related materials too.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: Being concrete and clear, as in 具体例 (concrete example).
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Give me one concrete example.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Clear and detailed.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Please explain more specifically.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: The same kind; similar.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: As last year, we'll hold a seminar this year too.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: A point to take care over.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: I put together points to watch when writing emails.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: Last: looking ahead.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Wishing for something to happen.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Please tell us the date and time you would like.
lines.name: 木村

segments.meaning: from now on, in the future

lines.en: From now on.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: We look forward to working with you from here on.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: What is actually happening.

lines.en: Reality doesn't go to plan.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Picturing in your mind something that is not there.

lines.en: Let's imagine ourselves ten years from now.

lines.en: We'll build the team around younger staff.

lines.en: Giving an example, for instance.

lines.en: Give two examples.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: Giving something, or an effect, to someone.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: This result had a big effect on the plan.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Pleasing and desirable.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: A cheerful greeting makes a good impression.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: Finally, let's check with a quiz. Choose the answer from 1 to 4.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Question 1. Which word goes in the brackets?
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The answer is 2: 開始, starts.
lines.name: ナレーター

segments.promptEn: What is looking at answers and giving marks called?

lines.en: Question 2. What is looking at answers and giving marks called?

segments.promptEn: It'll be over in ___ an hour.
